newsitem.title: UK: Greycoat awaits full Moorfield proposals.
newsitem.headline: Greycoat awaits full Moorfield proposals.

text.p: British property group Greycoat Plc said on Thursday it still has to see concrete proposals from Moorfield Estates, which wants a merger of the two and then a possible demerger of Greycoat's largest property assets.

"We have yet to see any detailed proposals from Moorfield. As we keep saying we will consider those proposals once they are received. So far we have only seen one page of vague bullet points," a Greycoat spokesman told Reuters.
Earlier a resolution by rebel shareholders to break up Greycoat was adjourned for three weeks so that the Moorfield approach could be looked at by the Greycoat board.
